note: Hand-kept. Not verified data: always check the operator before travelling. price {min,max} spans different products (e.g. 1-day to 1-year vignette) and must never be shown as a trip cost; show trip_price (one way, no contract) with its basis and conditions. price is null when no figure was read on an opened operator page. Endpoint lat/lon are approximate matcher hints, not surveyed.

entries.name: Oresund bridge (Malmo - Copenhagen)

trip_price.basis: one way, car up to 6 m, paid at the toll station, no contract

entries.conditions: Passenger car up to 6 m, one way, incl. 25% VAT. 470 DKK at the toll station, 420 DKK online ticket, 182 DKK with the OresundGO contract (plus 370 DKK annual fee). Prices valid from 2026-09-14. Page gave no SEK figures.

entries.name: Rodby - Puttgarden ferry (Scandlines)
entries.conditions: Low Price from 48 EUR one way: online only, selected departures while supplies last, car up to 6 m, booked departure only, not refundable, bookable until 2026-12-22, includes ETS surcharge. Standard and flexible fares are higher and were not read.

entries.name: Gedser - Rostock ferry (Scandlines)
entries.conditions: One way from-prices: Low Price 65.30 (online only, booked departure), Standard 82.70, Flex 157. Harbour prices are higher (from 147 / 198 for Standard / Flex). The page did not label these explicitly as car fares; vehicle class not confirmed.

entries.name: Norway tolls (Svinesund and AutoPASS network)
entries.conditions: All Norwegian toll stations are automated; rates depend on vehicle data (register fuel/emission data). A payment account must be registered or an invoice is sent; tags come from toll service providers. Prices vary per station and were not read.

entries.name: Austria motorway vignette
entries.conditions: Passenger car (Pkw), 2026 vignette, incl. 20% VAT: 1 day 9.60, 10 days 12.80, 2 months 32.00, year 106.80. From vignette year 2027 only the digital vignette is sold; 2027 prices not published on the page. Some tunnel/pass sections carry separate tolls.

entries.name: Czech e-vignette
entries.conditions: Passenger car up to 3.5 t, standard fuel, valid from 2026-01-01: 10 days 300, 30 days 480, 1 year 2570. Cheaper tiers exist for plug-in hybrids (CO2 up to 50 g/km: 70 / 120 / 640 CZK) and gas; foreign-registered electric cars must submit an exemption notice. Check the PHEV tier applies to the owner car.

entries.name: Slovak e-vignette
entries.conditions: Passenger car (category M1), incl. VAT: 1 day 8.10, 10 days 10.80, 30 days 17.10, 365 days 90.00.

entries.name: Slovenia e-vignette
entries.conditions: Toll class 2A (most cars, SUVs, minivans): weekly 16.00, monthly 32.00, annual 117.50. Class depends on vehicle height; confirm class for the car.
